ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with approximately 40% high-intensity white pixels localized on the lateral lobes and 60% low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels in the central and basal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary white contiguous zones on the distal halves of both lobes; the right white zone contains three distinct vertical black high-contrast streaks near the trailing edge; central region consists of solid black pigmentation with diffuse gray mottling at the white-black interface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression at approximately 90-100 degrees with a sharp vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency jagged serration along the entire trailing edge; notable large macro-notch (U-shaped indentation) on the inner trailing edge of the right lobe approximately one-third of the way from the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips, with the tips exhibiting a sharp upward and outward taper.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of 3-4 orange/brown circular protrusions (barnacles) on the far-left distal tip; smaller dark focal spots visible on the far-right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple horizontal and diagonal light-gray linear marks (rake marks) concentrated in the central-left dark region; fine vertical scratches visible across the white pigment of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A significant semi-circular chunk of tissue missing from the right lobe trailing edge; presence of active barnacle colonization on the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical black 'drip' patterns on the white field of the right lobe, oriented perpendicular to the trailing edge.
